about: Regina is Saskatchewan’s capital, on the open prairie in the south of the province. Wascana Centre — a large urban park around an artificial lake — occupies much of the city’s core beside the legislature. The city is a government, farm, and energy-services centre. About 230,000 people live in Regina.
